corpus_name: SCN Phase 3 ReData and land-protection policy corpus
generated_for: Sovereign Compute Nexus Phase 3 bounded policy classifier
research_note: This is the curated working corpus used to frame ReData as a data-center incentive problem constrained by Brazilian environmental, indigenous, protected-land, and consultation law. Journal entries were identified from publisher/DOI pages because the scite MCP was unavailable due to account usage limits. 2026-09-23 update: MP 1.318/2025 is recorded as lapsed and Lei 15.504/2026 (sanctioned 2026-09-15) as the Redata law in force; Lei 15.190/2025 (licensing), Decreto 12.772/2025 (PNAST), ANEEL REN 1.122/2025, Anatel Res. 780/2025 + Acordao 58/2026, CONAMA Mocao 147/2026, Convenio ICMS 38/2026 and three 2026 Camara bills were added. Every document now carries a lifecycle 'status'; entries marked 'unverified' or with a status_note saying a URL/date was not opened must be checked before publication. scripts/build_policy_corpus.py validate-corpus enforces the schema.

documents.title: Lei No. 15.504/2026 - Regime Especial de Tributacao para Servicos de Datacenter (Redata)
documents.status_note: Sanctioned 2026-09-15, published in the DOU 2026-09-16. No VETADO markers in the Planalto text on 2026-09-23. Regulating decree pending (art. 11-B §8, art. 11-C §§4-6).
documents.phase3_use: The incentive in force. Eligibility (art. 11-B §1): 100% of electricity demand contracted from renewable/low-emission generation; Water Usage Effectiveness <= 0.05 L/kWh for cooling, measured annually; >= 10% of effective supply to the domestic market; 2% of the value of acquired products into R&D&I. North/Northeast/Center-West projects get a 20% reduction of the commitments (art. 11-B §7). Art. 11-J: five-year term, but the PIS/Pasep, Cofins and IPI benefits 'produzirao efeitos ate 31 de dezembro de 2026' (tax-reform transition to CBS/IBS) - verify this reading before modelling incentive duration. Amends Lei 11.196/2005 and Lei 15.211/2025.

documents.title: Lei No. 15.190/2025 - Lei Geral do Licenciamento Ambiental
documents.issuer: Presidencia da Republica / Planalto; Congresso Nacional (partes promulgadas apos derrubada de vetos)
documents.status_note: Sanctioned with vetoes in Aug 2025; Congress overrode 52 veto items on 2025-11-27 (Senado Notícias); in force since Feb 2026 with ADIs pending at the STF (Agência Brasil, 2026-02). Two texts exist: as sanctioned and as promulgated after the override - cite the compiled text. Sanction day (08) and URL casing not re-verified on 2026-09-23.
documents.phase3_use: Replaces the licensing baseline Phase 3 assumed from LC 140/2011 + CONAMA 428/2010 alone: licenca por adesao e compromisso (LAC), licenca ambiental especial (LAE) for strategic projects, and changed rules for consultation of UC managers and buffer zones. Re-derive the Critical/Medium licensing triggers from this text; PL 5209/2026 would add data-center-specific licensing rules on top of it.

documents.title: Decreto No. 12.772/2025 - Politica Nacional de Acesso ao Sistema de Transmissao (PNAST)
documents.status_note: Published 2025-12-08 (Agência iNFRA). Planalto URL follows the standard pattern but was not opened on 2026-09-23; decree date may be a few days before publication.
documents.phase3_use: Transmission access becomes a competitive process: demands are registered with the ONS in 'access seasons' and auctioned, with a 10-month transition for prior requests. ONS reported 38 access requests totalling 7,040 MW from data centers (Conjur, 2026-08-20). For Phase 4 this turns grid proximity from a distance feature into an access-scarcity constraint.

documents.title: Resolucao Normativa ANEEL No. 1.122/2025 - garantias financeiras e prazos para acesso de grandes cargas a Rede Basica
documents.status_note: Approved 2025-05-20; effective 2026-01-01 (guarantee requirements immediately). URL follows the ANEEL CEDOC pattern and was not opened on 2026-09-23 - confirm. Summary source: Campos Mello Advogados.
documents.phase3_use: Access to the transmission grid now requires financial guarantees (GPA = 3 months of TUST at the access request; GPC = 3 years of EUST before contracting; GMI = 3 years of EUST for interest beyond the 4-year horizon), a 90-day window to sign the CCT and a single 12-month MUST postponement. A candidate site without a guaranteed connection is not grid-ready; use as a Medium trigger where connection status is unknown.

documents.phase3_use: Data centers connected to telecom networks fall under Anatel conformity assessment (safety, efficiency, sustainability). Shows that a regulatory instrument can be partially suspended by the agency's own board - the corpus needs a status per article, not per act, when this matters.

documents.phase3_use: The state-adoption field is the incentive geography: federal Redata does not imply ICMS relief in a given state. Record per-state adhesion (and later 'adesao' convenios) before using fiscal incentives as an opportunity layer.
